title: Coin counter ke limits lagao
instruction: Har coin group uski limit wale counter par rakho. Limit total offered amount ki hai, coin ke denomination ki nahi.

pieces.label: ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10, ₹20 coins
pieces.right: Book is group ke liye ₹1,000 tak limit deti hai. Har denomination ki alag ₹1,000 allowance mat jodo.
pieces.wrong: ₹10 ceiling se 50-paise rule lag jaayega; no-tender slot valid coin group ko hata dega.

pieces.label: 50 paise coin
pieces.right: 50-paise coins ke total amount ki legal-tender limit ₹10 tak hai.
pieces.wrong: ₹1,000 ceiling rupee-coin rule hai; 50 paise ko below-50 group mein rakhna bhi galat hai.

pieces.label: 50 paise se neeche ke coins
pieces.right: Book ke mutabik demonetized hain: koi positive legal-tender payment limit nahi.
pieces.wrong: ₹10 ya ₹1,000 counter par rakhne se demonetized coins ko legal-tender status wapas de doge.

win: Rupee coins: ₹1,000; 50 paise: ₹10; below 50 paise: no longer legal tender.
